mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retrieval_runs ( id, workspace_id, knowledge_base_id, question, strategy, status, embedding_model, rerank_model, configuration ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{question}, 'HYBRID_RRF_RERANK', 'RUNNING', #{embeddingModel}, #{rerankModel}, CAST(#{configuration} AS jsonb) )

INSERT INTO retrieval_candidates ( id, retrieval_run_id, workspace_id, stage, chunk_id, document_id, document_version_id, rank, score, metadata ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{runId}, #{workspaceId}, #{candidate.stage}, #{candidate.hit.chunkId}, #{candidate.hit.documentId}, #{candidate.hit.documentVersionId}, #{candidate.rank}, #{candidate.score}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb) )

INSERT INTO retrieval_stage_summaries ( retrieval_run_id, workspace_id, stage, status, candidate_count, latency_ms, error_code, metadata ) VALUES ( #{runId}, #{workspaceId}, #{summary.stage}, #{summary.status}, #{summary.candidateCount}, #{summary.latencyMs}, #{summary.errorCode}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb) )
mapper.update: UPDATE retrieval_runs SET status = 'COMPLETED', latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, final_stage = #{finalStage}, degradation_code = #{degradationCode}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE retrieval_runs SET status = 'FAILED', latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
